pairing.title: Connect your Range
pairing.subtitle: We'll find your ETarget device on the local network.
pairing.manualIpHint: Connected to the Range Wi-Fi but nothing showed up? Type the device address (e.g. 192.168.4.1) and connect directly.
pairing.manualIpInvalid: Enter a valid IP address or host, e.g. 192.168.4.1
pairing.trustBody: Verify the fingerprint matches the one printed on your device.
pairing.wifiInstructions: Open Wi-Fi settings → join the network 'etarget-XXXX' → return here.
pairing.demoBody: Try the app with a built-in demo Range. Hits are simulated locally on your phone.
pairing.connectIntro: Your Range broadcasts its own Wi-Fi network. iOS doesn't let apps switch networks for you, so a couple of taps are needed.
pairing.connectStep4: Tap “Use without internet” if iOS asks.
pairing.connectStep5: Come back here and tap “I'm connected”.
pairing.notFoundBody: Make sure you're on the etarget-1 Wi-Fi and the device is powered on, then try again.

home.noRangeConnected: No Range connected. Connect a device to continue.

session.resetConfirm: Reset session? This will clear all hits.
session.pausedBanner: Session paused — incoming hits will be ignored.

custom.title: Custom session
custom.subtitle: Build a program: choose how many targets and how many shots per target.
custom.targetsHint: How many targets you'll shoot in total (1–50).
custom.shotsPerTargetHint: How many shots fill one target before it clears (1–50).

free.title: Free shooting
free.subtitle: Just shoot. The target advances every N hits and the session keeps going until you end it.
free.shotsPerTargetHint: After this many hits the target clears and a new one begins (1–50).
free.openEndedValue: Unlimited — ends when you say so

calibration.title: Calibrate the target
calibration.subtitle: Confirm the camera on {{name}} is aligned before you start.
calibration.demoPreview: Live preview not available in Demo mode.
calibration.checklist1: Target paper is centred and flat.
calibration.checklist2: Bullseye is visible in the preview, no obstructions.
calibration.checklist3: Camera is steady and the lighting is consistent.
calibration.leaveBody: Calibration is required before you can use this Range. You can resume later from Settings.
calibration.autoAdjustHelp: Auto adjust averages ~25 frames over ~2.5s for olympic-grade stability. Lock horizontal forces both rotations to 0° (handy when the paper is mounted square but the bull detector picked up a few degrees of jitter).
calibration.positionHint: Move the centre of the rings.
calibration.shapeHint: Scale, squash and rotate the rings to match the printed paper.
calibration.cameraHint: Compensate for the camera being above/below, to the side, or off-axis from the paper.
calibration.paperHint: Adjust just the blue rectangle (visual only — does not affect scoring).
